findings.title: Uncaught exception: renderWelcomeBanner is not defined

steps: An uncaught exception was thrown: renderWelcomeBanner is not defined
consoleExcerpt:
ReferenceError: renderWelcomeBanner is not defined
    at http://localhost:4321/dashboard:26:5

findings.suggestedFix: Fix the thrown error; an uncaught exception can halt the rest of the page script (other features silently stop working).

findings.title: Failed request: GET /api/stats → 500

steps: The page requested GET http://localhost:4321/api/stats which returned HTTP 500

findings.suggestedFix: The API endpoint errors (5xx). Check the server handler; the page likely shows stale or missing data.

findings.title: Submit button does nothing

steps: Fill the form with valid values
Nothing happens: no navigation, no request, no message, no visible change

findings.suggestedFix: Wire the submit handler (or form action). A dead submit button blocks the whole flow.

findings.title: Form state lost on back navigation

steps: Enter a value in the first field
The value was wiped (state not preserved)

findings.suggestedFix: Preserve multi-step form state (keep it in state/store or restore it on back) so users do not lose their progress.

findings.title: Multi-step flow dead-ends (no enabled way forward)

steps: The only forward/finish control stays disabled — the flow cannot be completed

findings.suggestedFix: Enable the forward/finish control when the step is valid, or provide another way to complete the flow.

findings.title: Form submits but shows no success feedback

steps: A request was sent, but the UI shows no success message, redirect, or change

findings.suggestedFix: Render a clear success state (message/redirect) after the request resolves; users cannot tell if the action worked.

findings.title: Elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds (2 elements)

steps: axe-core WCAG check "color-contrast" failed: Ensure the contrast between foreground and background colors meets WCAG 2 AA minimum contrast ratio thresholds

element:

Trusted by thousands of shoppers worldwide. Shop the latest deals today.

findings.suggestedFix: Elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds. See https://dequeuniversity.com/rules/axe/4.11/color-contrast?application=playwright

findings.title: Images must have alternative text

steps: axe-core WCAG check "image-alt" failed: Ensure elements have alternative text or a role of none or presentation
element:

findings.suggestedFix: Images must have alternative text. See https://dequeuniversity.com/rules/axe/4.11/image-alt?application=playwright

findings.title: Broken external link: https://nonexistent-sniff-test-xyz.invalid/ (request failed (apiRequestContext.fetch: getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND nonexistent-sniff-test-xyz.invalid))

steps: On /, the link to https://nonexistent-sniff-test-xyz.invalid/ does not resolve

findings.suggestedFix: Update or remove the dead external link.

findings.title: Empty table with no empty-state ("Your Orders")

steps: The "Your Orders" table rendered with zero rows/items and no empty-state message

findings.suggestedFix: Either load the data or render a clear empty-state ("You have no orders yet"). A silently empty table reads as a bug.

findings.suggestedFix: Replace placeholder/mock data with real content (or guard it out of production builds).

findings.suggestedFix: Replace placeholder/mock data with real content (or guard it out of production builds).

findings.title: Invalid email accepted without validation

steps: No validation error fires and the value is accepted

findings.suggestedFix: Validate the email field (use type="email" or explicit validation) and show an inline error for invalid input.

findings.title: Loading spinner never resolves

steps: A loading indicator is still spinning after the page has had ample time to settle
A request likely hung and the UI is stuck loading

findings.suggestedFix: Add a timeout/fallback for the pending request and resolve the loading state (render data, an empty state, or an error).

findings.title: Failed request shows no error state to the user

steps: The page shows no error message, retry, or fallback — the failure is silent

findings.suggestedFix: Render a visible error state when a request fails (message + retry), instead of swallowing the error.

findings.title: Horizontal overflow at mobile width

steps: The document scrolls horizontally: content is 1424px wide in a 375px viewport. Widest offender: <div.too-wide> at 1400px.

findings.suggestedFix: Constrain fixed-width elements (use max-width:100%, overflow-x handling, or responsive units) so the page fits the viewport.

findings.title: Form control without an accessible label (1)

steps: Found input(s) with no <label>, aria-label, or title: email

findings.suggestedFix: Associate a <label for> (or aria-label) with every form control so screen readers and clicks on the label work.

findings.title: Tap targets below 24x24px (3)

steps: Found 3 control(s) smaller than the 24x24px minimum: "Buy" 22x14px, "Cancel" 34x14px, "Help" 25x14px

findings.suggestedFix: Give interactive controls at least a 24x24px (ideally 44x44px) touch area via padding/min-height.

findings.title: Primary action "checkout" is hard to find

steps: The primary action "checkout" is rendered with low prominence: tiny font (11px)

findings.suggestedFix: Give the primary action clear visual prominence (readable size, sufficient contrast, obvious placement).
